status.en: 382 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 19% fewer than the week before, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.

summary.en: Security forces have seized a Kuki-Zo camp in Manipur, arresting 17 militants and confiscating 24 firearms, while also taking control of the Sinai camp and planning audits of all SoO camps. In Kashmir, IGP Sujit Kumar reviewed crime disposal, winter preparedness and policing measures across the region, and a youth was injured in a bear attack in South Kashmir. The Kuki-Zo Women’s Forum has called for President's Rule in Manipur, describing the crisis as political rather than security related. Gaurav Gogoi again questioned the Centre's response and demanded accountability. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker har tatt kontroll over en Kuki-Zo-leir i Manipur, arrestert 17 militante og konfiskert 24 skytevåpen, samtidig som de har overtatt Sinai-leiren og planlegger revisjoner av alle SoO-leirer. I Kashmir har IGP Sujit Kumar gjennomgått kriminalitetsbehandling, vinterberedskap og polititiltak i regionen, og en ungdom ble skadet i et bjørnangrep i Sør-Kashmir. Kuki-Zo-kvinnesamfunnet har krevd presidentstyre i Manipur og beskriver krisen som politisk snarere enn sikkerhetsrelatert. Gaurav Gogoi stilte igjen spørsmål ved sentralstyrets respons og krevde ansvarlighet. 437 dødsfall i kamp ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
